key_insight: An uncertainty-conditioned AI framework converts genomic predictions into traceable, graph-supported phenotype hypotheses, with uncertainty explicitly shaping hypothesis breadth.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support research into variant–phenotype links, but the abstract does not establish patient-level diagnostic utility.
method: Combine sequence predictions and calibrated uncertainty with biomedical knowledge graphs.
Score gene–disease–phenotype paths using a learned energy function and uncertainty-dependent temperature.
Aggregate path probabilities into phenotype hypotheses without patient-level phenotype supervision.
evidence_signal: On AlzKB and Hetionet, phenotype entropy correlated with upstream uncertainty (Spearman 0.951 and 0.878); under gene hold-out, recall@10 exceeded trained DistMult on 24 of 30 graph masks (0.183 versus 0.123).
watch_item: The gene hold-out advantage was driven mainly by three genes with many variants and is not established across all genes.
paper_title: From Sequence Uncertainty to Phenotype Hypotheses: Uncertainty-Conditioned Inference over Biomedical Knowledge Graphs
